description: A curated reference library of approved drawings from the kirupa.com Pixel set, as text sprites: every drawing the skill cites, the smiley, person and hand family that faces depend on, and a few exemplars per category. It is not the full set; see assets/LICENSE.md for the license and https://www.kirupa.com/tools/icon_gallery_pixel.htm for the whole set.
pixelSha256: sha256 of the drawing's RGBA bytes (row-major, clear pixels 0,0,0,0), as rendered by scripts/sprite_tool.py

icons.name: face with open eyes and hand over mouth
